quick.title: Your observation for today
quick.free_placeholder: A word about your day with her (optional)

full.title: Your observation for today.
full.disclaimer: Note what you observed. Not what she feels — you don't know. No judgment.
full.free_placeholder: What you observe, in your own words. No one but you will read it.
full.loop_hint: Fuel for the cross-cycle memory. Don't skip it.
full.helped_placeholder: e.g. I canceled dinner so we could have some peace
full.not_helped_placeholder: e.g. I argued about the weekend to-do list

definitions.dispute: A disagreement or some tension between you, even brief.
definitions.fatigue: She seems tired, drained, short on sleep.
definitions.repli: A need for space and quiet, less wish to talk.
definitions.coquin: A wish for physical closeness, play, flirting.
definitions.tendresse: Hugs, gentle gestures, a need for affection.
definitions.rires: Funny moments, lightness, fits of laughter.
definitions.bon-moment: A good moment together, worth remembering.
definitions.energie: Full of drive, wanting to do, go out, start things.
definitions.pulsion: An urge to tidy, sort, reorganise the home.
definitions.conversation: A deep talk — about you two, life, what matters.

note.title: Your note
note.choose_date: Choose the day of the note
note.helped_hint: For example: a quiet evening, her favourite dish.
note.not_helped_hint: For example: arguing, suggesting a night out.
note.free_hint: What you observed, in your own words.
note.no_ai: No automatic analysis: your note stays yours and only feeds your echoes.
note.saved_body: You’ll find it in your journal, and it will come back as an echo at the same moment of the next cycle.
